subject.title: [优化建议] 添加结构化错误处理和智能重试机制

question: Which installer npm failures should OpenClaw auto-retry or auto-repair, and where should it only print remediation guidance?
rationale: The source shows a real first-run diagnostics and recovery gap, but transient retry policy, npm prefix mutation, and optional setup probe strictness can change existing install behavior across platforms.

options.title: Define a narrow policy, then implement
options.body: Retry only classified idempotent network failures, add EACCES/ENOSPC/EBADENGINE guidance or platform-specific repair, and cover Bash plus PowerShell with focused tests.

options.title: Guidance-only diagnostics
options.body: Keep install control flow mostly unchanged but improve known npm failure messages with concrete remediation commands and docs links.

options.title: Keep current partial behavior
options.body: Accept current npm code/syscall/errno output and targeted cleanup retries without adding a broader installer error policy.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow policy, then implement
recommendation.body: Retry only classified idempotent network failures, add EACCES/ENOSPC/EBADENGINE guidance or platform-specific repair, and cover Bash plus PowerShell with focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the broadest recent cross-platform history across Bash installer, PowerShell installer, and Docker setup surfaces.
